keyword: how long does it take to get to the moon and back to earth
claims: A round trip to the Moon and back generally takes about 6 to 10 days using conventional spacecraft.
Travel to lunar orbit takes roughly 3 to 4 days.
Return to Earth from lunar orbit takes roughly 3 to 4 days.
Apollo missions averaged roughly 3 days each way.
Artemis missions plan for a roughly 10-day round trip.
Apollo 8 reached lunar orbit in 69 hours and 8 minutes.
Apollo 17 journey, including lunar surface time, took over 12 days to complete in 1972.
Artemis II mission is scheduled to take around 10 days to orbit the Moon and return to Earth.
Distance to the Moon is roughly 238,900 miles.
Light takes 1.52 seconds to travel to the Moon.
New Horizons robotic probe took ~8 hours to the Moon.
Apollo missions took ~3 days to reach the Moon
